title: Complete-hand online PPO exact clean-boundary resume
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: A synchronous complete-hand on-policy update can preserve retained Adam and reproduce the next rollout and optimizer update exactly across a clean boundary.
material_change: Isolated new regimen gamma/lambda1 with eta0 versus eta0.1, terminal commitment bounds shifted by exact future regularization, inactive parent replay and fixed Standard10 opponent; not full RNaD or old-regimen continuation.
notes: Preregister four arms seed1/3 eta0/.1; each 16 prefix plus16 uninterrupted plus16 intentional replay hands.128 unique decks;192 live executions plus384 target/commitment reconstructions. This is a diagnostic training fixture, not efficacy. No production restart authorized by boundary-only proof.

result.summary: Four online retained-Adam arms passed exact next-rollout, weights, optimizer, RNG, counters and metrics equality after disk restore.192 live training fixture executions plus384 deterministic target/commitment reconstructions;128 unique decks.
result.conclusion: Clean synchronous update-boundary continuation is exact in these CPU fixtures.192 live hands include64 intentional restored duplicate deals; lineage counters total128 unique live deals. The evaluation_hands field denotes reconstruction fixtures, not strength evaluation. No Slumbot or efficacy evidence. Original parent Adam/replay/pool artifacts unchanged and hash bound; old replay inactive by explicit new regimen. Complete production crash-tail journaling and throughput still needed.
result.decision: Keep the regularized-return intervention as the sole candidate; do not promote these tiny diagnostic checkpoints or claim full RNaD.
result.next_step: Integrate batched full-chronology collection with durable per-update evidence and source binding, then run a preregistered two-seed eta0 matched bounded learning curve. Use common deal namespaces across treatment/control in efficacy trial; qualification namespaces were deliberately distinct and do not estimate treatment effect.
